card.name: Words about how long a reaction lasts
card.fires_on: Words describing whether an adverse event lasts or goes away, such as reversible, persists, lasting and resolved. They usually follow a reaction or grade, or an adverb like usually.

modes.description: Persists or lasting after a graded reaction, in rules for holding or reducing a drug.
